decisions.decision: Do not classify sub-1 RLUSD payments as spam solely by amount or automation. Keep a micro-payment class and promote to x402-compatible only when recipient address and protocol evidence match.
decisions.reason: The three Bitquery collector addresses exactly match known x402 merchant addresses; payment sizes align with published service pricing.

decisions.topic: x402 paid requests versus ledger transactions
decisions.decision: Store paid-request count, session count, XRPL Payment count, CheckCreate count and CheckCash count as separate measures.
decisions.reason: t54's batch settlement uses two ledger transactions per session regardless of request count; 213,008 paid requests were settled in 3,162 sessions and 6,324 ledger transactions.

decisions.decision: Use service merchant identity, payer/receiver uniqueness, price schedule, paid-request count, settled value and session conversion. Keep raw on-ledger transaction count as an infrastructure metric, not an adoption proxy.
decisions.reason: Batch settlement changes the relationship between paid requests and ledger transactions; a Payment-only index misses Checks.

decisions.decision: Use behavior-only labels such as x402-compatible cohort, operator unknown, production/test unknown. Do not infer malicious intent or Binance corporate involvement.
decisions.reason: Funding wallet labels and exact merchant matches do not identify the customer or operator.

decisions.decision: Separate XRP fees and reserves from RLUSD-denominated paid requests; do not infer proportional XRP spot purchases from RLUSD x402 volume.
decisions.reason: The observed cohort paid in RLUSD and paid network fees in XRP; the two flows have different economic meanings.

decisions.decision: Represent Coinbase, Circle, Ripple and Mastercard as members of the vendor-neutral x402 standard, with distinct asset/network implementations.
decisions.reason: Linux Foundation identifies Coinbase as protocol contributor and lists Coinbase, Circle, Ripple, Mastercard and t54 Labs among founding members; public statements distinguish USDC from XRP/RLUSD implementations.

required_features: x402 paid requests by merchant, payer and asset
x402 session count and average requests per session
XRPL Payment, CheckCreate and CheckCash counts by asset and source cohort
settled value by asset, with issuer mint/redeem separated
merchant address identity and published per-call price version
unique payer/merchant counts and cohort funding source with attribution confidence
protocol version and facilitator deployment/beta dates
network fee in XRP separately from payment principal in RLUSD or XRP
